from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    """Stamp copies of the rare colored motif onto matching all-zero cells."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    colors = [v for v in counts if v != 0]
    motif_color = min(colors, key=lambda v: counts[v])
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == motif_color]
    r0 = min(r for r, c in points)
    c0 = min(c for r, c in points)
    shape = [(r-r0, c-c0) for r, c in points]
    sh, sw = max(r for r, c in shape)+1, max(c for r, c in shape)+1
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dy][c+dx] == 0 for dy, dx in shape):
                for dy, dx in shape:
                    out[r+dy][c+dx] = motif_color
    return out
